chapter: Queens Terrace, Decca records and Amen
title: USO camp shows from Fort Lewis to Boston
summary: His first USO tour runs from Fort Lewis through Salt Lake and the Boston harbor ports.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And then you went out on the camp shows?
I went out on that same day.

The first time I played. I went down to Fort Lewis, and came back Salt Lake City; all the way back up to Boston, played all those ports on the harbor of Boston and came back to New York and New Jersey.
That would have taken you a nice couple of months, it must have been all winter that you were doing that.
